# graphiant_prefix_set (Data Source)

Global prefix sets, looked up by id. This is read-only: the API has no create/update/delete endpoint for prefix sets anywhere, only this lookup-by-id-list. Individual prefix entries and attached-policy references are not yet exposed — only top-level prefix set metadata.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_prefix_set" "example" {
  ids = [201, 202]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ids` (List of Number)

### Read-Only

- `prefix_sets` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prefix_sets))

<a id="nestedatt--prefix_sets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prefix_sets`

- `global_id` (Number)

- `mode` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `policy_count` (Number)
- `status` (String)
